AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

19. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)

   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

20. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)

   B. newton (N)

   D. pascal (Pa)
